```{r load-stats}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

stats <- tryCatch(
  yaml::read_yaml("data/scholar_stats.yml"),
  error = function(e) list(
    citations_all = "—",
    h_index_all   = "—",
    i10_index_all = "—"
  )
)

pubs_n <- tryCatch({
  pubs <- read.csv("data/publications.csv")
  # Datasets, code archives and journal appendices are records of their own in
  # OpenAlex, but they are shown as Code/Data links on the parent paper's page
  # (data/paper_links.yml) and get no page of their own, so they are not counted
  # as publications here either.
  deposit_types <- c("dataset", "software", "supplementary-material",
                     "supplementary-materials")
  is_deposit <- pubs$type %in% deposit_types |
    grepl("^(https?://(dx\\.)?doi\\.org/)?10\\.(5281|6084|5061|15468)/",
          tolower(pubs$doi))
  nrow(pubs[!is_deposit, ])
}, error = function(e) "—")
```
